task_text: Go to youtube.com search for Iron Maiden - The Trooper and play the first video that pops up. If at any point an ad is shown skip the add. Mute any video or ad that shows up. When the video starts playing watch for 30s fast forward for 30s and then watch for 10s then pause the video for 20s and the play for another 15s. If at any point any pop-ups happen dismiss them.
